title: Botanias
description: Mod for new plants, farm crops and trees
body:
The mod introduces 2 new trees and interior items from them. 1 new venus flytrap mob. 3 new farm plants (beans, melon, onion). 9 new wild plants and various food and potion crafts from them.
There is also a new workbench and several new structures where you can find seeds of farm plants.
